scope: Trusted local Git reconstruction, dependency/build evidence and product handoff. No GPU, image execution or inference claims.

findings.title: Timed-out builds leave untracked live descendants and no reconciliation record
findings.attempt: Authorize build argv running Python that spawns a child (separate cwd, stdout/stderr DEVNULL), then sleeps. Child sleeps1.5s and writes a marker only under this review probe directory. materialize(timeout=1).
findings.observed: BUILD_TIMEOUT raised after1.56s; marker absent at error and present2s later. No attempt/log files were added to the host store and no package was published. Native child effects continued after the returned error.
findings.impact: The caller cannot inspect or reconcile an identified original build; retrying can overlap surviving effects. Trusted-local scope permits execution but does not establish cessation.
findings.general_fix: Reserve and persist a build attempt identity before dispatch, record process identity/generation and logs, preserve partial artifacts and an unknown state when whole-tree cessation is unconfirmed. Provide lookup/reconciliation before retry. Confirm process-tree stop when supported; do not infer it from direct-parent timeout.

findings.title: Failure discards build stdout, exit history and reconstruction observations
findings.attempt: Build argv prints build diagnosis stdout, prints separate stderr, exits7.
findings.observed: CCError BUILD_FAILED contains only stderr. No new store files or durable build record. The preceding fetch/base/tree/lock observations and stdout are discarded with the temporary directory.
findings.impact: Failures and interruptions cannot be audited or diagnosed from retained execution evidence, despite docs04/11/12 requiring retained failures and observations.
findings.general_fix: Persist phase commands, exit codes, stdout and stderr separately for every outcome, with source-change/base/tree/lock identities and failing phase in a durable failure/attempt record. No executable package should be published for failed work.

findings.title: Unresolved Git LFS objects can be published as complete payload material
findings.attempt: Stage .gitattributes with weights.bin filter=lfs plus a standard pointer to unavailable sha256:111...111,size123456. Apply the verified binary patch. Authorized build copies weights.bin into dist alongside the service.
findings.observed: Materialization succeeds and publishes release15c469...; payload/weights.bin is the literal LFS pointer. GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 prevents object retrieval, and only submodule modes are checked.
findings.impact: The bounded profile accepts omitted required LFS bytes rather than reporting unsupported source material, conflicting with doc12 omission row and risking a nominally built candidate with missing weights.
findings.general_fix: Detect tracked LFS-managed pointers before build/publishing and reject with UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE_MATERIAL unless an explicit supported resolved-material profile binds/verifies the object bytes. Document separately admitted external weights instead of presenting unresolved pointer files as their material.

findings.title: An unchanged pinned source cannot be built through the source-change profile
findings.attempt: Use exact existing base commit and its tree with a verified zero-byte patch artifact, leaving the normal build recipe unchanged.
findings.observed: PATCH_REJECTED: No valid patches in input (allow with --allow-empty). The repository is complete; no source modification is needed.
findings.impact: Factory cannot use this profile to build an existing paper/application revision without inventing a source edit.
findings.general_fix: Support an empty patch as a no-op while still checking exact base and resulting tree, for example git apply --allow-empty on check/apply. Alternatively expose a documented exact-base build path that preserves the same evidence.

verified_boundaries: Template and caller repository remain separate; fresh checkout receives the patch.
Immutable full base/tree IDs and patch digest verification are checked; git apply checks/index application precede expected-tree comparison.
Missing dependency lock, changed tracked source/index and nonempty output checks exist; dependencies are not installed implicitly.
Build authority is explicit trusted_build=True and distinct from runtime start grants.
Successful payload is copied into a package with generated provenance and prepared before destination publication.
Product demonstration uses actual synthetic Git patch/build, inspector, HTTP startup/readiness/invocation and stop. Its CPU-only limitation is explicit.
Docs distinguish build success, readiness, qualification, installation eligibility, actual loaded generation and independent measurement.
notes: A dependency-lock hash identifies the supplied file; it does not prove installed dependencies or full environment closure. This limitation is explicitly documented.
Build records point to patch/source locators; transferable delivery must retain the referenced bytes or clearly identify unavailable rebuild material.
The four probe changes and outcomes are retained in factory-review-probe-evidence.json. No production implementation/docs edited.
